_readme: S526 SkyJostaberry, 2026-10-30. Three courses on Glendale's unequal and incomplete records carry no units: CS/IS 187 (IT Technician III 36600/36601, which print 13 courses 'to a total of 42') and FTVM 132 and 137 (Grip and Lighting 44572). The parsed descriptions (kb/program_requirements_units/glendale_community.json, S523) hold none of the three, though the state's file (coci_program_courses) prices all three at 3.0. This read prints the description pages (128-301) naming them, to see whether the catalog prints them at all. One load of the 2025-2026 PDF, no model call.

questions.course_units: Whether the catalog prints a description for CS/IS 187, FTVM 132 and FTVM 137, and the units each states.
